description.full_text: The image depicts a wooden cabinet with a warm, natural finish. The cabinet features a drawer at the top with a horizontal handle made of wood and metal. Below the drawer are two doors, each with a vertical handle that combines wood and metal elements. The design appears classic and understated, with no visible text. The atmosphere is calm and simple, emphasizing the cabinet's craftsmanship and material.
